items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Dick Gibson did a movie?' and 'Dick Gibson's', but the interviewee does not mention Dick Gibson by name nor describe any personal interaction or relationship with him.

ctx.x: That's why I like this thing up at Colorado, you know. He might put you on with anybody. He might put on a swing guy up there with some modern guys. A couple of swing guys. And it's a challenge. You never know who you're going to play with. This last time he had John Faddis playing with Eubie U.B. Blake. John Faddis is 22 and U.B. Blake is 94. And they tore up the house. They played -- they played the most beautiful thing on "Memories of You", the thing that -- it's going to be in the movie -- in that movie he's…
